# FQHESphereGetDimension

Module: **FQHE** · directory: `FQHE/src/FQHEOnSphere` · binary: `FQHE/src/Programs/FQHEOnSphere/FQHESphereGetDimension`

```text
FQHESphereGetDimension, version 0.01

Usage: FQHESphereGetDimension [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -n, --nbr-particles : number of particles (default value = 4)
    -s, --nbr-flux : number of flux quanta (default value = 20)
    --total-lz : Lz sector (default value = 0)
    --total-sz : spin projection for SU(2) case (default value = 0)
    --fermion : use fermionic statistic instead of bosonic statistic
    --boson : use bosonic statistics
    --4-D : consider particles on the 4D sphere (only available for bosons)
    --su2-spin : consider particles with SU(2) spin
    --su3-spin : consider particles with SU(3) spin
    --su2su2-spin : consider particles with SU(2)xSU(2) spin
    --su4-spin : consider particles with SU(4) spin
    --2-ll : consider particles within two Landau levels
    --3-ll : consider particles within three Landau levels
    --cp2 : consider particles on the CP2 
    --ground-only : get the dimension only for the largest subspace
    --use-files : use dimension files that have been previously generated to increase speed. Files must be in current directory and obey the statistics_sphere_n_nbrparticles_q_nbrfluxquanta.dim naming convention

output options:
    --save-disk : save output on disk
    --output-file : use this file name instead of statistics_sphere_n_nbrparticles_q_nbrfluxquanta.dim

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
